verdict: No blocker found for this narrowly scoped source-only control; typechecking and execution remain necessary.
verified: The preimage and four dependent source pins match both base commit and current workspace. Forward/reverse patch checks and apply reproduce the exact candidate/preimage; removing the one added test reproduces all original source bytes.

Virtual clock trace from pinned code: leader activation at 10 sets grace deadline 1010; follower ACK contacts at 11 and 12 and strict-majority match commit the term barrier at index 1; the 13 ms positive proposal appends beyond committed index 1 without new contacts; at 1013 ms the last contacts are 1002 and 1001 ms old, so the 1000 ms quorum window and activation grace both expire.

The added control checks a nonempty index-1 committed barrier, prior positive proposal position, rejected stale proposal, follower transition, unchanged WAL bytes, tail, committed index, and committed record sequence. The WAL path uses the same id/directory derivation as DynamicGroup::open.

Node::propose calls leader(now) before the log append; the checked expiry path steps down there before returning NotLeader. The owner clock and volatile role can still change; equal WAL bytes are not a claim that no state changed.
The existing catch_up helper can perform up to four bounded in-process exchanges per follower during setup. The patch does not retry either proposal or alter the original observer test.

The retry design requires a separately proven typed preappend outcome, one absolute deadline, bounded attempts/in-flight work, stopping on cancellation or ambiguous errors, and retains the unchanged observer control. It explicitly does not infer retry safety from a formatted NotLeader message.
compile_plausibility: The test uses existing helper methods, u64 timestamps, Copy RecordKind, comparable Record/LogPosition types, fs import and Result conversions; reviewed statically only, no claim it compiles.
limitations: No Cargo/native build, typecheck, runtime tests, live Kafka, Fetch, network, registry, or publication. The added test is unexecuted.
A single genesis/lease-expiry path cannot prove all NotLeader responses are preappend or determine either CI failure cause; a different failure can occur after an append at advance_commit.
The c034 observer failure and 337 removal failure have distinct observed operations; later state snapshots do not establish a complete event ordering or show whether a removal mutated state.
